#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
"yearly_total" AS (
    SELECT 
        c2."db_year",
        COUNT(*) AS "total_accidents"
    FROM "collisions" c
    JOIN "case_ids" c2 ON c."case_id" = c2."case_id"
    WHERE c2."db_year" IN (2011, 2021)
    GROUP BY c2."db_year"
),
"category_counts_2021" AS (
    SELECT 
        c."pcf_violation_category",
        COUNT(*) AS "cnt"
    FROM "collisions" c
    JOIN "case_ids" c2 ON c."case_id" = c2."case_id"
    WHERE c2."db_year" = 2021
      AND c."pcf_violation_category" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c."pcf_violation_category"
),
"top_category" AS (
    SELECT 
        "pcf_violation_category"
    FROM "category_counts_2021"
    ORDER BY "cnt" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
"category_counts" AS (
    SELECT 
        c2."db_year",
        COUNT(*) AS "category_count"
    FROM "collisions" c
    JOIN "case_ids" c2 ON c."case_id" = c2."case_id"
    WHERE c2."db_year" IN (2011, 2021)
      AND c."pcf_violation_category" = (SELECT "pcf_violation_category" FROM "top_category")
    GROUP BY c2."db_year"
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SELECT "category_count" FROM "category_counts" WHERE "db_year" = 2011) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT "total_accidents" FROM "yearly_total" WHERE "db_year" = 2011)
        -
        (SELECT "category_count" FROM "category_counts" WHERE "db_year" = 2021) * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT "total_accidents" FROM "yearly_total" WHERE "db_year" = 2021)
        , 4
    ) AS "decrease_percentage_points"
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Count accidents per year per primary collision factor violation category
accidents_by_year_category AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', "collision_date") AS "year",
        "primary_collision_factor_violation_category",
        COUNT(*) AS "accident_count"
    FROM "collisions"
    WHERE "collision_date" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY "year", "primary_collision_factor_violation_category"
),
-- Step 2: Get total accidents per year
total_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        "year",
        SUM("accident_count") AS "total_accidents"
    FROM accidents_by_year_category
    GROUP BY "year"
),
-- Step 3: Calculate annual share per category per year
share_by_year_category AS (
    SELECT 
        a."year",
        a."primary_collision_factor_violation_category",
        a."accident_count",
        t."total_accidents",
        ROUND(a."accident_count" * 100.0 / t."total_accidents", 4) AS "share_percentage"
    FROM accidents_by_year_category a
    JOIN total_by_year t ON a."year" = t."year"
),
-- Step 4: Find the most common violation category in 2021
top_category_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        "primary_collision_factor_violation_category"
    FROM share_by_year_category
    WHERE "year" = '2021'
    ORDER BY "share_percentage" DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
-- Step 5: Compare shares between 2011 and 2021 for that category
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SELECT "share_percentage" 
         FROM share_by_year_category 
         WHERE "year" = '2021' 
           AND "primary_collision_factor_violation_category" = (SELECT * FROM top_category_2021))
        -
        (SELECT "share_percentage" 
         FROM share_by_year_category 
         WHERE "year" = '2011' 
           AND "primary_collision_factor_violation_category" = (SELECT * FROM top_category_2021)),
    4) AS "percentage_point_change";
```
</details>

```sql
WITH 
-- Player basic info
player_info AS (
    SELECT 
        "player_id",
        "player_name",
        "batting_hand",
        "bowling_skill"
    FROM "player"
),

-- Most frequent role for each player
player_role_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        "player_id",
        "role",
        COUNT(*) AS role_count
    FROM "player_match"
    GROUP BY "player_id", "role"
),
player_top_role AS (
    SELECT 
        "player_id",
        "role" AS most_frequent_role
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            "player_id",
            "role",
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY role_count DESC) AS rn
        FROM player_role_counts
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),

-- Batting totals per player
player_batting AS (
    SELECT 
        "striker" AS "player_id",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "match_id") AS total_matches_played,
        SUM("runs_off_bat") AS total_runs,
        SUM("ball_id_ball") AS total_balls_faced,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_dismissals,
        MAX("runs_off_bat") AS highest_score,  -- will be refined to max per match
        SUM(CASE WHEN "runs_off_bat" >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_above_30_raw,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "runs_off_bat" >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_above_50_raw,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "runs_off_bat" >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_above_100_raw
    FROM "ball_by_ball"
    GROUP BY "striker"
),

-- Highest score per match for each player
player_match_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        "striker" AS "player_id",
        "match_id",
        SUM("runs_off_bat") AS match_total
    FROM "ball_by_ball"
    GROUP BY "striker", "match_id"
),
player_max_score AS (
    SELECT 
        "player_id",
        MAX(match_total) AS highest_score
    FROM player_match_scores
    GROUP BY "player_id"
),
player_match_thresholds AS (
    SELECT 
        "player_id",
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_above_30,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_above_50,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_above_100
    FROM player_match_scores
    GROUP BY "player_id"
),

-- Bowling stats per player
player_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        "bowler" AS "player_id",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "match_id") AS bowling_matches,
        SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" != '' AND "wicket_type" != 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_wickets, -- Exclude run outs
        SUM("runs_off_bat" + COALESCE("extra_runs", 0)) AS total_runs_conceded, -- runs from bat + extras (excluding extras runs as per instruction, but we include all for economy)
        COUNT(*) AS total_balls_bowled
    FROM "ball_by_ball"
    GROUP BY "bowler"
),

-- Best bowling performance per player (most wickets, fewest runs ties)
player_match_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        "bowler" AS "player_id",
        "match_id",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" != '' AND "wicket_type" != 'run out' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
        SUM("runs_off_bat" + COALESCE("extra_runs", 0)) AS runs_given
    FROM "ball_by_ball"
    GROUP BY "bowler", "match_id"
),
player_best_bowling AS (
    SELECT 
        "player_id",
        wickets || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            "player_id",
            wickets,
            runs_given,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given ASC) AS rn
        FROM player_match_bowling
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)

-- Final query combining all stats
SELECT 
    p."player_id",
    p."player_name",
    COALESCE(pr."most_frequent_role", 'Unknown') AS most_frequent_role,
    p."batting_hand",
    p."bowling_skill",
    COALESCE(pb."total_runs", 0) AS total_runs,
    COALESCE(pb."total_matches_played", 0) AS total_matches_played,
    COALESCE(pb."total_dismissals", 0) AS total_dismissals,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(pb."total_dismissals", 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(pb."total_runs", 0) AS REAL) / pb."total_dismissals", 4)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS batting_average,
    COALESCE(pms."highest_score", 0) AS highest_score,
    COALESCE(pmt."matches_above_30", 0) AS matches_above_30,
    COALESCE(pmt."matches_above_50", 0) AS matches_above_50,
    COALESCE(pmt."matches_above_100", 0) AS matches_above_100,
    COALESCE(pb."total_balls_faced", 0) AS total_balls_faced,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(pb."total_balls_faced", 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND((CAST(COALESCE(pb."total_runs", 0) AS REAL) / pb."total_balls_faced") * 100, 4)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS strike_rate,
    COALESCE(pbw."total_wickets", 0) AS total_wickets,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(pbw."total_balls_bowled", 0) > 0 
        THEN ROUND((CAST(COALESCE(pbw."total_runs_conceded", 0) AS REAL) / pbw."total_balls_bowled") * 6, 4)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS economy_rate,
    COALESCE(pbb."best_bowling_performance", '0-0') AS best_bowling_performance
FROM player_info p
LEFT JOIN player_top_role pr ON p."player_id" = pr."player_id"
LEFT JOIN player_batting pb ON p."player_id" = pb."player_id"
LEFT JOIN player_max_score pms ON p."player_id" = pms."player_id"
LEFT JOIN player_match_thresholds pmt ON p."player_id" = pmt."player_id"
LEFT JOIN player_bowling pbw ON p."player_id" = pbw."player_id"
LEFT JOIN player_best_bowling pbb ON p."player_id" = pbb."player_id"
ORDER BY p."player_id";
```
</details>

```sql
-- CTE to compute total extras per ball (since extra_runs table may have multiple rows per ball)
WITH extra_by_ball AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        over_id,
        ball_id,
        SUM(extra_runs) AS extra_total
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id
),
-- Enrich each ball with runs scored and extras
ball_data AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.striker,
        b.non_striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) AS runs_scored,
        COALESCE(e.extra_total, 0) AS extra_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
        ON b.match_id = bs.match_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    LEFT JOIN extra_by_ball e
        ON b.match_id = e.match_id
        AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
        AND b.over_id = e.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id
),
-- Aggregate by match and unordered player pair
partnership_agg AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        MIN(striker, non_striker) AS player1,   -- smaller ID
        MAX(striker, non_striker) AS player2,   -- larger ID
        SUM(runs_scored) + SUM(extra_runs) AS partnership_total,
        -- Individual runs when the player is the striker
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker < non_striker THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS individual1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker > non_striker THEN runs_scored ELSE 0 END) AS individual2
    FROM ball_data
    GROUP BY match_id, player1, player2
),
-- Rank partnerships per match by total runs
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        player1,
        player2,
        individual1,
        individual2,
        partnership_total,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_total DESC) AS rnk
    FROM partnership_agg
)
-- Final output: reorder players by individual score (desc), then by player ID (desc) in case of tie
SELECT
    match_id,
    CASE
        WHEN individual1 > individual2 THEN player1
        WHEN individual2 > individual1 THEN player2
        ELSE player2   -- if individual scores equal, higher ID becomes player1
    END AS player_id_1,
    CASE
        WHEN individual1 > individual2 THEN player2
        WHEN individual2 > individual1 THEN player1
        ELSE player1
    END AS player_id_2,
    CASE
        WHEN individual1 > individual2 THEN individual1
        WHEN individual2 > individual1 THEN individual2
        ELSE individual2   -- player1' score = individual2 (since player2 has higher ID)
    END AS individual_score_1,
    CASE
        WHEN individual1 > individual2 THEN individual2
        WHEN individual2 > individual1 THEN individual1
        ELSE individual1
    END AS individual_score_2,
    partnership_total
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY match_id, player_id_1; -- order for readability
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
partner_balls AS (
    SELECT 
        "match_id",
        CASE WHEN "striker" < "non_striker" THEN "striker" ELSE "non_striker" END AS "player_low",
        CASE WHEN "striker" < "non_striker" THEN "non_striker" ELSE "striker" END AS "player_high",
        "runs_scored",
        "striker" AS "striker_id",
        "non_striker" AS "non_striker_id"
    FROM "ball_by_ball"
    WHERE "runs_scored" IS NOT NULL
),
pair_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        "match_id",
        "player_low",
        "player_high",
        SUM("runs_scored") AS "partnership_runs",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "striker_id" = "player_low" THEN "runs_scored" ELSE 0 END) AS "score_low",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "striker_id" = "player_high" THEN "runs_scored" ELSE 0 END) AS "score_high"
    FROM partner_balls
    GROUP BY "match_id", "player_low", "player_high"
),
global_max AS (
    SELECT MAX("partnership_runs") AS "max_runs" FROM pair_scores
)
SELECT 
    p."match_id",
    CASE 
        WHEN p."score_low" > p."score_high" THEN p."player_low"
        WHEN p."score_high" > p."score_low" THEN p."player_high"
        ELSE CASE WHEN p."player_low" > p."player_high" THEN p."player_low" ELSE p."player_high" END
    END AS "player1_id",
    CASE 
        WHEN p."score_low" > p."score_high" THEN p."player_high"
        WHEN p."score_high" > p."score_low" THEN p."player_low"
        ELSE CASE WHEN p."player_low" > p."player_high" THEN p."player_high" ELSE p."player_low" END
    END AS "player2_id",
    CASE 
        WHEN p."score_low" > p."score_high" THEN p."score_low"
        WHEN p."score_high" > p."score_low" THEN p."score_high"
        ELSE p."score_low"
    END AS "player1_score",
    CASE 
        WHEN p."score_low" > p."score_high" THEN p."score_high"
        WHEN p."score_high" > p."score_low" THEN p."score_low"
        ELSE p."score_high"
    END AS "player2_score",
    p."partnership_runs"
FROM pair_scores p
JOIN global_max g ON p."partnership_runs" = g."max_runs"
ORDER BY p."match_id", "player1_id", "player2_id"
LIMIT 1;
```
</details>

```sql
-- Step 1: Identify each customer's first payment (earliest payment_date, tie-break by payment_id)
WITH ranked_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        "customer_id",
        "rental_id",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY "customer_id" 
            ORDER BY "payment_date" ASC, "payment_id" ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM "Payment"
),
first_rentals AS (
    SELECT 
        "customer_id",
        "rental_id"
    FROM ranked_payments
    WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Step 2: Compute per-customer totals (total amount spent and total rentals)
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        "customer_id",
        SUM("amount") AS total_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT "rental_id") AS total_rentals
    FROM "Payment"
    GROUP BY "customer_id"
)
-- Step 3: Join first rentals to film via rental -> inventory -> film, then aggregate by rating
SELECT 
    "f"."rating" AS first_movie_rating,
    ROUND(AVG("ct"."total_amount"), 4) AS avg_total_amount,
    ROUND(AVG("ct"."total_rentals" - 1), 4) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_rentals "fr"
JOIN "Rental" "r" ON "fr"."rental_id" = "r"."rental_id"
JOIN "Inventory" "i" ON "r"."inventory_id" = "i"."inventory_id"
JOIN "Film" "f" ON "i"."film_id" = "f"."film_id"
JOIN customer_totals "ct" ON "fr"."customer_id" = "ct"."customer_id"
GROUP BY "f"."rating"
ORDER BY "f"."rating";
```
</details>

```sql
WITH 
-- Clean salary values: remove currency symbol, commas, convert monthly to annual
cleaned_salaries AS (
    SELECT 
        "Location",
        "CompanyName",
        CASE 
            WHEN "Salary" LIKE '%/mo' THEN 
                CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Salary", '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/mo', '') AS REAL) * 12
            ELSE 
                CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE("Salary", '₹', ''), ',', ''), '/yr', '') AS REAL)
        END AS annual_salary
    FROM "SalaryDataset"
    WHERE "Location" IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
),
-- Average salary per company per city
city_company_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        "Location",
        "CompanyName",
        ROUND(AVG("annual_salary"), 4) AS avg_salary_in_state
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    GROUP BY "Location", "CompanyName"
),
-- National average across all four cities
national_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG("annual_salary"), 4) AS avg_salary_in_country
    FROM cleaned_salaries
),
-- Rank companies within each city by average salary descending
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT 
        cca."Location",
        cca."CompanyName",
        cca.avg_salary_in_state,
        na.avg_salary_in_country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cca."Location" 
            ORDER BY cca.avg_salary_in_state DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rank
    FROM city_company_avg cca
    CROSS JOIN national_avg na
)
-- Final output: top 5 per location
SELECT 
    "Location",
    "CompanyName",
    avg_salary_in_state AS "Average Salary in State",
    avg_salary_in_country AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY "Location", rank;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH cleaned_data AS (
  SELECT
    "Location",
    "CompanyName",
    CAST(
      REPLACE(
        REPLACE(
          REPLACE(
            REPLACE("Salary", ',', ''),
            '₹', ''
          ),
          '$', ''
        ),
        '%', ''
      ) AS REAL
    ) AS "CleanSalary"
  FROM "SalaryDataset"
  WHERE "Salary" IS NOT NULL
    AND "Salary" != ''
),
city_company_avg AS (
  SELECT
    "Location",
    "CompanyName",
    ROUND(AVG("CleanSalary"), 4) AS "AvgSalaryInState"
  FROM cleaned_data
  WHERE "Location" IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
  GROUP BY "Location", "CompanyName"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    "Location",
    "CompanyName",
    "AvgSalaryInState",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY "Location"
      ORDER BY "AvgSalaryInState" DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS "rn"
  FROM city_company_avg
),
national_avg AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG("CleanSalary"), 4) AS "AvgSalaryInCountry"
  FROM cleaned_data
)
SELECT
  r."Location" AS "Location",
  r."CompanyName" AS "CompanyName",
  r."AvgSalaryInState" AS "AverageSalaryInState",
  n."AvgSalaryInCountry" AS "AverageSalaryInCountry"
FROM ranked r
CROSS JOIN national_avg n
WHERE r."rn" <= 5
ORDER BY r."Location", r."AvgSalaryInState" DESC NULLS LAST;
```

```sql
WITH
-- Step 1: Compute monthly balance per customer for 2020 (only deposit and withdrawal)
"monthly_balances" AS (
    SELECT
        "customer_id",
        CAST(strftime('%m', "txn_date") AS INTEGER) AS "month",
        SUM(CASE WHEN "txn_type" = 'deposit' THEN "txn_amount" ELSE 0 END) -
        SUM(CASE WHEN "txn_type" = 'withdrawal' THEN "txn_amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "balance"
    FROM "customer_transactions"
    WHERE strftime('%Y', "txn_date") = '2020'
      AND "txn_type" IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY "customer_id", "month"
),
-- Step 2: Count customers with positive balance per month
"monthly_positive_counts" AS (
    SELECT
        "month",
        COUNT(*) AS "customer_count"
    FROM "monthly_balances"
    WHERE "balance" > 0
    GROUP BY "month"
),
-- Step 3: Rank months by count (highest and lowest)
"ranked_months" AS (
    SELECT
        "month",
        "customer_count",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "customer_count" DESC) AS "rn_desc",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "customer_count" ASC)  AS "rn_asc"
    FROM "monthly_positive_counts"
),
-- Step 4: Extract the highest and lowest months
"target_months" AS (
    SELECT "month", 'highest' AS "type" FROM "ranked_months" WHERE "rn_desc" = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "month", 'lowest'  AS "type" FROM "ranked_months" WHERE "rn_asc"  = 1
),
-- Step 5: Compute average balance across all customers for each month
"monthly_avg_balance" AS (
    SELECT
        "month",
        ROUND(AVG("balance"), 4) AS "avg_balance"
    FROM "monthly_balances"
    GROUP BY "month"
)
-- Step 6: Calculate the difference between the two averages
SELECT
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN "type" = 'highest' THEN "avg_balance" END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN "type" = 'lowest'  THEN "avg_balance" END)
    , 4) AS "difference"
FROM "target_months" t
JOIN "monthly_avg_balance" a ON t."month" = a."month";
```
</details>


<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH actor_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        TRIM(mc."PID") AS "PID",
        CAST(m."year" AS INTEGER) AS "year"
    FROM "M_Cast" mc
    JOIN "Movie" m ON mc."MID" = m."MID"
    WHERE m."year" IS NOT NULL 
      AND m."year" != ''
),
actor_career AS (
    SELECT 
        "PID",
        MIN("year") AS "first_year",
        MAX("year") AS "last_year"
    FROM actor_years
    GROUP BY "PID"
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "actor_count"
FROM actor_career ac
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM actor_years ay1
    WHERE ay1."PID" = ac."PID"
      AND ay1."year" >= ac."first_year"
      AND ay1."year" <= ac."last_year" - 3
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM actor_years ay2
          WHERE ay2."PID" = ac."PID"
            AND ay2."year" BETWEEN ay1."year" AND ay1."year" + 3
      )
);
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH actor_career_range AS (
    SELECT 
        "actor_id",
        MIN("year") AS "first_year",
        MAX("year") AS "last_year"
    FROM "credit"
    GROUP BY "actor_id"
),
actor_years AS (
    SELECT 
        ac."actor_id",
        ac."first_year",
        yr."year"
    FROM actor_career_range ac
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT "year" FROM "credit"
    ) yr
    WHERE yr."year" BETWEEN ac."first_year" AND ac."last_year"
),
actor_credit_flag AS (
    SELECT 
        ay."actor_id",
        ay."year",
        CASE WHEN c."actor_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "has_credit"
    FROM actor_years ay
    LEFT JOIN "credit" c ON ay."actor_id" = c."actor_id" AND ay."year" = c."year"
),
actor_gap_check AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        a1."actor_id"
    FROM actor_credit_flag a1
    JOIN actor_credit_flag a2 
        ON a1."actor_id" = a2."actor_id" AND a2."year" = a1."year" + 1
    JOIN actor_credit_flag a3 
        ON a1."actor_id" = a3."actor_id" AND a3."year" = a1."year" + 2
    JOIN actor_credit_flag a4 
        ON a1."actor_id" = a4."actor_id" AND a4."year" = a1."year" + 3
    WHERE a1."has_credit" = 0
      AND a2."has_credit" = 0
      AND a3."has_credit" = 0
      AND a4."has_credit" = 0
)

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS "actor_count"
FROM actor_career_range acr
WHERE acr."actor_id" NOT IN (SELECT "actor_id" FROM actor_gap_check);
```
</details>

```sql
WITH 
-- 合并所有比赛得分记录（当前表和归档表），只保留获胜且手分 <=190 的记录
all_scores AS (
    SELECT "BowlerID", "MatchID", "GameNumber", "HandiCapScore", "WonGame"
    FROM "Bowler_Scores"
    WHERE "WonGame" = 1 AND "HandiCapScore" <= 190
    UNION
    SELECT "BowlerID", "MatchID", "GameNumber", "HandiCapScore", "WonGame"
    FROM "Bowler_Scores_Archive"
    WHERE "WonGame" = 1 AND "HandiCapScore" <= 190
),
-- 合并所有比赛信息
all_matches AS (
    SELECT "MatchID", "TourneyID"
    FROM "Tourney_Matches"
    UNION
    SELECT "MatchID", "TourneyID"
    FROM "Tourney_Matches_Archive"
),
-- 合并所有锦标赛信息
all_tournaments AS (
    SELECT "TourneyID", "TourneyLocation", "TourneyDate"
    FROM "Tournaments"
    UNION
    SELECT "TourneyID", "TourneyLocation", "TourneyDate"
    FROM "Tournaments_Archive"
),
-- 连接得分、比赛、锦标赛，筛选三个指定地点的记录
filtered_games AS (
    SELECT 
        s."BowlerID",
        s."MatchID",
        s."GameNumber",
        s."HandiCapScore",
        t."TourneyLocation",
        t."TourneyDate"
    FROM all_scores s
    JOIN all_matches m ON s."MatchID" = m."MatchID"
    JOIN all_tournaments t ON m."TourneyID" = t."TourneyID"
    WHERE t."TourneyLocation" IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
-- 找出在三个地点都至少有一条获胜记录（手分 <=190）的保龄球手
bowlers_with_all_venues AS (
    SELECT "BowlerID"
    FROM filtered_games
    GROUP BY "BowlerID"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "TourneyLocation") = 3
)
-- 最终输出：球手信息 + 具体比赛记录
SELECT 
    b."BowlerID",
    b."BowlerFirstName",
    b."BowlerLastName",
    f."MatchID" AS "MatchNumber",
    f."GameNumber",
    f."HandiCapScore",
    f."TourneyDate",
    f."TourneyLocation"
FROM filtered_games f
JOIN bowlers_with_all_venues bv ON f."BowlerID" = bv."BowlerID"
JOIN "Bowlers" b ON f."BowlerID" = b."BowlerID"
ORDER BY b."BowlerID", f."TourneyDate", f."MatchID", f."GameNumber";
```

```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Isolate winning games with handicap score <=190 at the three specific venues
winning_games_at_venues AS (
    SELECT 
        bs."BowlerID",
        bs."MatchID",
        bs."GameNumber",
        bs."HandicapScore",
        t."TourneyDate",
        t."TourneyLocation"
    FROM "Bowler_Scores" AS bs
    JOIN "Tourney_Matches" AS tm ON bs."MatchID" = tm."MatchID"
    JOIN "Tournaments" AS t ON tm."TourneyID" = t."TourneyID"
    WHERE bs."WonGame" = 1
      AND bs."HandicapScore" <= 190
      AND t."TourneyLocation" IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes')
),
-- Step 2: Count distinct venues per bowler; keep only those who have all three
bowlers_with_all_three AS (
    SELECT "BowlerID"
    FROM winning_games_at_venues
    GROUP BY "BowlerID"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "TourneyLocation") = 3
)
-- Step 3: Output the specific game records for qualifying bowlers, with bowler names
SELECT 
    wg."BowlerID",
    b."BowlerFirstName",
    b."BowlerLastName",
    wg."MatchID",
    wg."GameNumber",
    wg."HandicapScore",
    wg."TourneyDate",
    wg."TourneyLocation"
FROM winning_games_at_venues AS wg
JOIN bowlers_with_all_three AS bwa ON wg."BowlerID" = bwa."BowlerID"
JOIN "Bowlers" AS b ON wg."BowlerID" = b."BowlerID"
ORDER BY wg."BowlerID", wg."MatchID", wg."GameNumber";
```

The quintiles should be labeled as "First" (top 20%), "Second" (top 21-40%), "Third" (top 41-60%), "Fourth" (top 61-80%), and "Fifth" (bottom 20%).
```sql
WITH english_courses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s."SubjectID"
    FROM "Subjects" s
    LEFT JOIN "Categories" cat ON s."CategoryID" = cat."CategoryID"
    WHERE LOWER(s."SubjectName") LIKE '%english%'
       OR LOWER(s."SubjectCode") LIKE '%eng%'
       OR LOWER(cat."CategoryDescription") LIKE '%english%'
),
completed_enrollments AS (
    SELECT 
        ss."StudentID",
        ss."Grade",
        ss."ClassID"
    FROM "Student_Schedules" ss
    INNER JOIN "Classes" c ON ss."ClassID" = c."ClassID"
    INNER JOIN english_courses ec ON c."SubjectID" = ec."SubjectID"
    WHERE ss."ClassStatus" = 2
      AND ss."Grade" IS NOT NULL
),
student_grades AS (
    SELECT 
        st."StudLastName" AS last_name,
        ce."Grade",
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY ce."Grade" DESC) AS quintile_rank
    FROM completed_enrollments ce
    INNER JOIN "Students" st ON ce."StudentID" = st."StudentID"
)
SELECT 
    last_name,
    CASE 
        WHEN quintile_rank = 1 THEN 'First'
        WHEN quintile_rank = 2 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN quintile_rank = 3 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN quintile_rank = 4 THEN 'Fourth'
        WHEN quintile_rank = 5 THEN 'Fifth'
    END AS quintile
FROM student_grades
ORDER BY quintile_rank ASC;
```

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH english_enrollments AS (
    SELECT 
        s.lastname AS LastName,
        e.grade AS Grade
    FROM enrollments e
    JOIN courses co ON e.courseid = co.courseid
    JOIN categories ca ON co.categoryid = ca.categoryid
    JOIN students s ON e.studentid = s.studentid
    WHERE ca.categorydescription = 'English'
      AND e.classstatus = 2
      AND e.grade IS NOT NULL
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM english_enrollments
)
SELECT 
    ee.LastName,
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_enrollments ee2 WHERE ee2.Grade >= ee.Grade) * 1.0 / t.total_count >= 0.8 THEN 'First'
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_enrollments ee2 WHERE ee2.Grade >= ee.Grade) * 1.0 / t.total_count >= 0.6 THEN 'Second'
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_enrollments ee2 WHERE ee2.Grade >= ee.Grade) * 1.0 / t.total_count >= 0.4 THEN 'Third'
        WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM english_enrollments ee2 WHERE ee2.Grade >= ee.Grade) * 1.0 / t.total_count >= 0.2 THEN 'Fourth'
        ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS quintile
FROM english_enrollments ee, total t
ORDER BY 
    CASE quintile
        WHEN 'First' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Second' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Third' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5
    END;
```

```sql
-- For each musical style, count the number of times it appears as 1st, 2nd, or 3rd preference

    "ms"."StyleName",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "mp"."PreferenceSeq" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "FirstPreferenceCount",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "mp"."PreferenceSeq" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "SecondPreferenceCount",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "mp"."PreferenceSeq" = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "ThirdPreferenceCount"

INNER JOIN "Musical_Styles" "ms"
    ON "mp"."StyleID" = "ms"."StyleID"

GROUP BY "ms"."StyleName"
ORDER BY "ms"."StyleName";
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        "first_pref" AS "musical_style",
        1 AS "preference_rank"
    FROM "musical_preferences"
    WHERE "first_pref" IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        "second_pref" AS "musical_style",
        2 AS "preference_rank"
    FROM "musical_preferences"
    WHERE "second_pref" IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        "third_pref" AS "musical_style",
        3 AS "preference_rank"
    FROM "musical_preferences"
    WHERE "third_pref" IS NOT NULL
)

-- Step 2: Count occurrences per style and preference rank, then pivot back to wide format
SELECT 
    "musical_style",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "preference_rank" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "first_pref_count",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "preference_rank" = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "second_pref_count",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "preference_rank" = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "third_pref_count"
FROM unpivoted_preferences
GROUP BY "musical_style"
ORDER BY "musical_style";
```

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
sales_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        soh."salespersonid" AS "BusinessEntityID",
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', soh."orderdate") AS INTEGER) AS "year",
        SUM(soh."subtotal") AS "total_sales"
    FROM "salesorderheader" soh
    WHERE soh."salespersonid" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY soh."salespersonid", STRFTIME('%Y', soh."orderdate")
),
quota_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        sph."BusinessEntityID",
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', sph."QuotaDate") AS INTEGER) AS "year",
        MAX(sph."SalesQuota") AS "quota"   -- one quota per year per person
    FROM "SalesPersonQuotaHistory" sph
    GROUP BY sph."BusinessEntityID", STRFTIME('%Y', sph."QuotaDate")
)
SELECT
    sp."businessentityid" AS "SalesPersonID",
    COALESCE(s."year", q."year") AS "Year",
    ROUND(COALESCE(s."total_sales", 0) - COALESCE(q."quota", 0), 4) AS "Difference"
FROM "salesperson" sp
LEFT JOIN sales_by_year s ON sp."businessentityid" = s."BusinessEntityID"
LEFT JOIN quota_by_year q ON sp."businessentityid" = q."BusinessEntityID"
    AND (s."year" = q."year" OR s."year" IS NULL)
```

<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
-- Step 1: Join movies, ratings, director_mapping, and names to get per-movie director data
movie_director_data AS (
    SELECT
        n."id" AS director_id,
        n."name" AS director_name,
        m."id" AS movie_id,
        m."date_published",
        m."duration",
        r."avg_rating",
        r."total_votes"
    FROM "movies" m
    INNER JOIN "director_mapping" dm ON m."id" = dm."movie_id"
    INNER JOIN "names" n ON dm."name_id" = n."id"
    LEFT JOIN "ratings" r ON m."id" = r."movie_id"
),
-- Step 2: Compute inter-movie durations using LAG window function
director_movie_intervals AS (
    SELECT
        director_id,
        director_name,
        movie_id,
        "date_published",
        "duration",
        "avg_rating",
        "total_votes",
        LAG("date_published") OVER (
            PARTITION BY director_id
            ORDER BY "date_published"
        ) AS prev_date
    FROM movie_director_data
),
-- Step 3: Aggregate per director
director_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        director_id,
        director_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT movie_id) AS movie_count,
        -- average inter-movie duration in days, rounded to nearest integer
        ROUND(AVG(
            CASE WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL
                 THEN JULIANDAY("date_published") - JULIANDAY(prev_date)
            END
        ), 0) AS avg_inter_duration,
        -- average rating rounded to 2 decimal places
        ROUND(AVG("avg_rating"), 2) AS avg_rating,
        SUM("total_votes") AS total_votes,
        MIN("avg_rating") AS min_rating,
        MAX("avg_rating") AS max_rating,
        SUM("duration") AS total_duration
    FROM director_movie_intervals
    GROUP BY director_id, director_name
)
-- Step 4: Select top 9 directors, sorted by movie_count desc then total_duration desc
SELECT
    director_id AS "ID",
    director_name AS "name",
    movie_count AS "number_of_movies",
    avg_inter_duration AS "average_inter_movie_duration",
    avg_rating AS "average_rating",
    total_votes AS "total_votes",
    min_rating AS "minimum_rating",
    max_rating AS "maximum_rating",
    total_duration AS "total_movie_duration"
FROM director_aggregates
ORDER BY movie_count DESC NULLS LAST,
         total_duration DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 9;
```
</details>

### 93. local272 (DB: `oracle_sql`)
**Question**: For order 423, identify the product IDs, aisles, and positions from which to pick the exact quantities needed for each order line, ensuring that the total picked quantity for each product matches the cumulative quantities ordered without exceeding the available inventory in warehouse 1. Calculate the quantities to be picked from each location by prioritizing inventory with earlier purchased dates and smaller quantities, and ensure that picking respects the sequence and cumulative quantities of the order lines for products with multiple entries.

**Status**: Baseline ❌ | SlayQL ❌

#### 📊 Execution Results Comparison

<summary><b>Baseline Execution Result (❌)</b></summary>

|   orderline_id |   product_id | aisle   |   position |   qty_picked |
|---------------:|-------------:|:--------|-----------:|-------------:|
|           9269 |         4280 | C       |          1 |           36 |
|           9269 |         4280 | D       |         18 |           24 |
|           9272 |         6520 | A       |         29 |           14 |
|           9272 |         6520 | C       |         13 |           20 |
|           9272 |         6520 | A       |         16 |            6 |

</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Define order lines for order 423, ordered by their id to define sequence
WITH ordered_lines AS (
    SELECT
        id AS orderline_id,
        product_id,
        qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY id) AS drn  -- demand row number per product
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),

-- Step 2: Compute cumulative demand per product (for overlap allocation)
demand_cum AS (
    SELECT
        orderline_id,
        product_id,
        qty,
        drn,
        SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY drn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_d,
        COALESCE(SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY drn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_cum_d
    FROM ordered_lines
),

-- Step 3: Get available inventory in warehouse 1, with purchase dates
inventory_warehouse1 AS (
    SELECT
        i.product_id,
        i.qty AS s_qty,
        i.location_id,
        l.aisle,
        l.position,
        COALESCE(p.purchased, '1900-01-01') AS purchased_date  -- use a default date for missing purchases
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    LEFT JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1 AND i.qty > 0
),

-- Step 4: Rank supply by earliest purchase date then smallest quantity
supply_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        location_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        s_qty,
        purchased_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased_date ASC, s_qty ASC, location_id ASC) AS srn
    FROM inventory_warehouse1
),

-- Step 5: Cumulative supply per product
supply_cum AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        location_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        s_qty,
        srn,
        SUM(s_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY srn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_s,
        COALESCE(SUM(s_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY srn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_cum_s
    FROM supply_ranked
)

-- Step 6: Join supply and demand where cumulative ranges overlap, compute allocated quantity
SELECT
    d.orderline_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.aisle,
    s.position,
    ROUND(MIN(s.cum_s, d.cum_d) - MAX(s.prev_cum_s, d.prev_cum_d), 4) AS qty_picked
FROM supply_cum s
JOIN demand_cum d ON s.product_id = d.product_id
    AND s.prev_cum_s < d.cum_d
    AND s.cum_s > d.prev_cum_d
WHERE MIN(s.cum_s, d.cum_d) - MAX(s.prev_cum_s, d.prev_cum_d) > 0
ORDER BY d.orderline_id, s.srn;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- This query provides the picking list for order 423 given the available tables.
-- Since the schema lacks order_lines, aisles, and positions, we assume:
--   - Inventory is stored in web_counter_hist (product_id = page_no, qty = counter, purchase_date = day).
--   - Product IDs come from web_pages.page_no.
--   - Warehouse 1 is assumed for all inventory (no warehouse column).
--   - Aisles and positions are not present; they are set to 'N/A'.
--   - Order lines for order 423 are entered manually as a CTE (replace with actual order table if exists).

WITH
-- Step 1: Define the order lines for order 423 (hardcoded example)
order_lines AS (
    SELECT 1 AS line_no, 2 AS product_id, 5 AS qty_ordered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 3, 3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 2, 4
),
-- Step 2: Get available inventory in warehouse 1 (all web_counter_hist assumed warehouse 1)
inventory AS (
    SELECT
        page_no AS product_id,
        counter AS qty_available,
        day AS purchase_date,
        'N/A' AS aisle,
        'N/A' AS position
    FROM web_counter_hist
    WHERE counter > 0
),
-- Step 3: For each product, assign a global rank by purchase_date (earlier first), then by qty (smaller first)
inventory_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        aisle,
        position,
        qty_available,
        purchase_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_id
            ORDER BY purchase_date ASC, qty_available ASC
        ) AS pick_priority
    FROM inventory
),
-- Step 4: For each product in order lines, compute cumulative needed quantity
order_cumulative AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(qty_ordered) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY line_no) AS cum_qty_needed
    FROM order_lines
),
-- Step 5: For each inventory lot, compute cumulative available quantity (running total)
inventory_cumulative AS (
    SELECT *,
        SUM(qty_available) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_id
            ORDER BY pick_priority
        ) AS cum_qty_available
    FROM inventory_ranked
),
-- Step 6: Join order and inventory to allocate FIFO
allocated AS (
    SELECT
        o.product_id,
        i.aisle,
        i.position,
        i.purchase_date,
        i.pick_priority,
        o.line_no,
        o.qty_ordered,
        o.cum_qty_needed,
        i.cum_qty_available,
        i.qty_available,
        -- Determine quantity to pick from this lot for this order line
        CASE
            WHEN o.cum_qty_needed - o.qty_ordered < i.cum_qty_available - i.qty_available
            THEN o.qty_ordered
            ELSE 
                CASE
                    WHEN o.qty_ordered <= (i.cum_qty_available - (o.cum_qty_needed - o.qty_ordered))
                    THEN o.qty_ordered
                    ELSE (i.cum_qty_available - (o.cum_qty_needed - o.qty_ordered))
                END
        END AS qty_to_pick_lot
    FROM order_cumulative o
    JOIN inventory_cumulative i
        ON o.product_id = i.product_id
        AND i.cum_qty_available - i.qty_available < o.cum_qty_needed
        AND i.cum_qty_available >= o.cum_qty_needed - o.qty_ordered
)
-- Step 7: Final output � for each order line, show the lots to pick and quantities
SELECT
    product_id,
    aisle,
    position,
    line_no,
    qty_to_pick_lot
FROM allocated
ORDER BY product_id, line_no, pick_priority;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH seller_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 4) AS total_sales,
        ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 4) AS avg_item_price,
        ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(rev.review_score, 0)), 4) AS avg_review_score,
        ROUND(AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_carrier_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)), 4) AS avg_packing_days,
        COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS total_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews rev ON oi.order_id = rev.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        tr.product_category_name_english AS category_name,
        SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales_volume
    FROM order_items oi
    LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation tr ON p.product_category_name = tr.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, tr.product_category_name_english
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.seller_id,
        cs.category_name,
        cs.category_sales_volume,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.seller_id ORDER BY cs.category_sales_volume DESC) AS rn
    FROM category_sales cs
)
SELECT 
    sa.seller_id,
    sa.total_sales,
    sa.avg_item_price,
    sa.avg_review_score,
    sa.avg_packing_days,
    sa.total_quantity,
    rc.category_name AS top_selling_category_english
FROM seller_agg sa
LEFT JOIN ranked_categories rc ON sa.seller_id = rc.seller_id AND rc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sa.total_sales DESC NULLS LAST;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        oi."seller_id",
        COUNT(*) AS total_sold_quantity,
        SUM(oi."price") AS total_sales,
        AVG(oi."price") AS avg_item_price,
        AVG(r."review_score") AS avg_review_score,
        AVG(
            julianday(o."order_delivered_carrier_date") - julianday(o."order_purchase_timestamp")
        ) AS avg_packing_time_days
    FROM "order_items" oi
    INNER JOIN "orders" o ON oi."order_id" = o."order_id"
    LEFT JOIN "order_reviews" r ON o."order_id" = r."order_id"
    GROUP BY oi."seller_id"
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
category_ranking AS (
    SELECT
        oi."seller_id",
        pc."product_category_name_english",
        COUNT(*) AS category_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY oi."seller_id"
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM "order_items" oi
    INNER JOIN "products" p ON oi."product_id" = p."product_id"
    LEFT JOIN "product_category_name_translation" pc 
        ON p."product_category_name" = pc."product_category_name"
    GROUP BY oi."seller_id", p."product_category_name"
)
SELECT
    sm."seller_id",
    ROUND(sm."total_sales", 4) AS total_sales,
    ROUND(sm."avg_item_price", 4) AS avg_item_price,
    ROUND(sm."avg_review_score", 4) AS avg_review_score,
    ROUND(sm."avg_packing_time_days", 4) AS avg_packing_time_days,
    cr."product_category_name_english" AS top_product_category
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN category_ranking cr 
    ON sm."seller_id" = cr."seller_id" AND cr."rn" = 1
ORDER BY sm."seller_id";
```
</details>

<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Compute age from birth_date (assumes birth_date is in YYYY-MM-DD format)
-- Age is approximated by difference in years using Julian day; adjust for current date
-- Categorize into 20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others
-- Count users per category

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(user_id) AS user_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    CAST(
      (julianday('now') - julianday(birth_date)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER
    ) AS age
  FROM mst_users
) AS ages
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN "age" >= 20 AND "age" <= 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN "age" >= 30 AND "age" <= 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN "age" >= 40 AND "age" <= 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN "age" >= 50 AND "age" <= 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS "age_category",
  COUNT(*) AS "user_count"
FROM "profiles"
WHERE "age" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "age_category"
ORDER BY
  CASE "age_category"
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    ELSE 5
  END;
```

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH -- Calculate positions with previous lap position
position_data AS (
    SELECT
        lp."race_id",
        lp."driver_id",
        lp."lap",
        lp."position",
        LAG(lp."position") OVER (
            PARTITION BY lp."race_id", lp."driver_id"
            ORDER BY lp."lap"
        ) AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions lp
    WHERE lp."lap_type" = 'Race'
),
-- Compute overtakes and overtaken for laps > 1
diffs AS (
    SELECT
        pd."race_id",
        pd."driver_id",
        pd."lap",
        pd."position",
        pd."prev_position",
        CASE WHEN pd."position" < pd."prev_position" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overtake,
        CASE WHEN pd."position" > pd."prev_position" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overtaken
    FROM position_data pd
    WHERE pd."lap" > 1
      AND pd."prev_position" IS NOT NULL
),
-- Exclude laps where the driver pitted or retired
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        d.*
    FROM diffs d
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps
        ON d."race_id" = ps."race_id"
        AND d."driver_id" = ps."driver_id"
        AND d."lap" = ps."lap"
    LEFT JOIN retirements r
        ON d."race_id" = r."race_id"
        AND d."driver_id" = r."driver_id"
        AND d."lap" = r."lap"
    WHERE ps."lap" IS NULL
      AND r."lap" IS NULL
)
-- Aggregate per driver and return those with more overtaken than overtakes
SELECT de."full_name" AS full_name
FROM filtered f
JOIN drivers_ext de ON f."driver_id" = de."driver_id"
GROUP BY f."driver_id"
HAVING SUM(f."overtaken") > SUM(f."overtake");
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
-- Step 1: Get all race lap-level position changes (excluding lap 1)
-- We need a lap-level positions dataset, but we only have results (final race result) and no per-lap table.
-- The database schema does NOT include a "lap_times" or "lap_positions" table in the provided schema.
-- Therefore, we cannot directly compute per-lap overtakes.
-- Instead, we must infer that the question expects us to use "results"."position_order"
-- as the starting position for each driver in a race, and that any change from start to finish
-- (excluding pit stops, retirements, and first-lap effects) represents net overtakes.
-- However, since we cannot filter per-lap pit entry/exit, we rely on the fact that pit stops
-- are recorded in "pit_stops" table, but no per-lap position data exists to link pit stops to position changes.
-- Given these constraints, a strict per-lap overtake count is impossible with provided schema.
-- Therefore, the only feasible interpretation is:
-- Compare each driver's "position_order" (finish) vs their "grid" (starting position) from "qualifying" table.
-- Count net positions gained as "overtakes_made" and net positions lost as "overtakes_taken".
-- Exclude races where the driver retired (join to "retirements" table on race_id and driver_id if available).
-- Exclude first lap by using starting grid positions (qualifying) as baseline.
-- This approximates the intent given data limitations.

-- First, get driver names and race results with qualifying grid
driver_net_overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        d.driver_id,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
        r.race_id,
        r.position_order AS finish_position,
        q.position AS grid_position,
        -- Net overtakes = grid - finish (positive means gained positions)
        (CASE WHEN r.position_order IS NOT NULL AND q.position IS NOT NULL
              THEN CAST(q.position AS INTEGER) - CAST(r.position_order AS INTEGER)
              ELSE 0
         END) AS net_overtakes
    FROM results AS r
    -- We need drivers table, but it's not in the provided schema. Assume it exists since "full name" is asked.
    -- For schema completeness, we assume a "drivers" table with driver_id, forename, surname.
    JOIN drivers AS d ON r.driver_id = d.driver_id
    JOIN races AS rc ON r.race_id = rc.race_id
    LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q ON r.race_id = q.race_id AND r.driver_id = q.driver_id
    -- Exclude retirements (if retirement table links to race and driver)
    LEFT JOIN retirements AS ret ON r.race_id = ret.race_id AND r.driver_id = ret.driver_id
    WHERE ret.retirement_type IS NULL
      -- Exclude first lap by using qualifying grid (lap 1 start) as baseline; no further first-lap filter needed
      AND q.position IS NOT NULL
)

-- Step 2: Aggregate per driver, count how many times they had positive net overtakes (overtook others)
-- and how many times they had negative net overtakes (were overtaken)
SELECT
    driver_full_name
FROM driver_net_overtakes
GROUP BY driver_full_name
HAVING
    -- Count of races where they lost positions (net overtakes < 0)
    SUM(CASE WHEN net_overtakes < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
    -- Count of races where they gained positions (net overtakes > 0)
    SUM(CASE WHEN net_overtakes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
ORDER BY driver_full_name;
```
</details>

```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Determine "first two full weeks of the previous year" (2023)
-- The first full week of 2023 starts Monday, Jan 2 (since Jan 1 is Sunday)
-- Two full weeks end on Sunday, Jan 15, 2023
"previous_year_weeks" AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE('2023-01-02') AS "first_week_start",
        DATE('2023-01-15') AS "first_weeks_end"
),
-- Step 2: Define "week ending after" the first two full weeks
-- The next week ends on Sunday, Jan 22, 2023
"target_week" AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE('2023-01-22') AS "week_end_date"
)
-- Step 3: Filter snowfall records for the target week (Jan 16 - Jan 22, 2023)
-- and keep only amounts > 6 inches
SELECT 
    w."postal_code",
    w."date",
    w."snowfall_amount"
FROM 
    "WEATHER_DATA" w
WHERE 
    w."date" >= DATE('2023-01-16')
    AND w."date" <= (SELECT "week_end_date" FROM "target_week")
    AND w."snowfall_amount" > 6
ORDER BY 
    w."postal_code", w."date";
```

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Identify the variable for total population 5-year estimates
WITH population_variables AS (
    SELECT "VARIABLE"
    FROM GLOBAL_GOVERNMENT.CYBERSYN.AMERICAN_COMMUNITY_SURVEY_ATTRIBUTES
    WHERE "MEASURE" = 'Population'
      AND "MEASUREMENT_TYPE" = 'Estimate'
      AND "UNIT" = 'Count'
      AND "FREQUENCY" = 'Annual'
      AND "VARIABLE" LIKE '%5YR%'
      AND LOWER("VARIABLE_NAME") LIKE '%total population%'  -- restrict to total population
),

-- Step 2: Get population estimates for all ZIP codes (Census ZCTA) for years 2014-2020
pop_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t."GEO_ID",
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") AS "YEAR",
        TRY_CAST(t."VALUE" AS FLOAT) AS "POPULATION"
    FROM GLOBAL_GOVERNMENT.CYBERSYN.AMERICAN_COMMUNITY_SURVEY_TIMESERIES t
    INNER JOIN population_variables pv ON t."VARIABLE" = pv."VARIABLE"
    WHERE t."GEO_ID" LIKE 'zip/%'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t."DATE") BETWEEN 2014 AND 2020
),

-- Step 3: Filter areas with at least 25,000 people in that year
filtered_pop AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM pop_data
    WHERE "POPULATION" >= 25000
),

-- Step 4: Attach state abbreviation for each ZIP code via geography relationships
state_info AS (
    SELECT 
        gr."GEO_ID" AS "ZIP_GEO_ID",
        -- ISO_3166_2_CODE is like 'US-CA', extract after 'US-'
        SUBSTRING(gi."ISO_3166_2_CODE", 4) AS "STATE_ABBREV"
    FROM GLOBAL_GOVERNMENT.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_RELATIONSHIPS gr
    INNER JOIN GLOBAL_GOVERNMENT.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_INDEX gi 
        ON gr."RELATED_GEO_ID" = gi."GEO_ID"
    WHERE gr."RELATED_LEVEL" = 'State'
      AND gr."RELATIONSHIP_TYPE" = 'Contains'
),

-- Step 5: Combine population with state and compute previous year population using LAG
pop_with_state AS (
    SELECT 
        fp."GEO_ID",
        fp."YEAR",
        fp."POPULATION",
        si."STATE_ABBREV",
        LAG(fp."POPULATION") OVER (PARTITION BY fp."GEO_ID" ORDER BY fp."YEAR") AS "PREV_POP"
    FROM filtered_pop fp
    LEFT JOIN state_info si ON fp."GEO_ID" = si."ZIP_GEO_ID"
),

-- Step 6: Compute annual growth rate and keep only years 2015-2020 with valid previous year
growth_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        "GEO_ID",
        "YEAR",
        "STATE_ABBREV",
        ROUND(
            ("POPULATION" - "PREV_POP") / NULLIF("PREV_POP", 0) * 100,
            4
        ) AS "GROWTH_RATE_PERCENT"
    FROM pop_with_state
    WHERE "YEAR" BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
      AND "PREV_POP" IS NOT NULL
      AND "PREV_POP" > 0
),

-- Step 7: Rank per year by growth rate descending
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        "GEO_ID",
        "YEAR",
        "STATE_ABBREV",
        "GROWTH_RATE_PERCENT",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "YEAR" ORDER BY "GROWTH_RATE_PERCENT" DESC) AS "RNK"
    FROM growth_rate
)

-- Step 8: Select second-highest per year and extract ZIP code from GEO_ID
SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r."GEO_ID", 5) AS "ZIP_CODE",  -- remove 'zip/' prefix
    r."STATE_ABBREV",
    r."GROWTH_RATE_PERCENT"
FROM ranked r
WHERE r."RNK" = 2
ORDER BY r."YEAR";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Identify population for each ZCTA for years 2014�2020 using ACS 5-year estimates
WITH pop_per_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        geo."ZCTA5" AS "zip_code",
        pop."YEAR",
        pop."VALUE" AS "population"
    FROM "US_CENSUS_ACS_POPULATION_ATTRIBUTES" pop
    INNER JOIN "US_CENSUS_GEOGRAPHY_INDEX" geo
        ON pop."GEO_ID" = geo."GEO_ID"
    WHERE pop."VARIABLE" = 'B01001_001E'              -- total population variable
      AND pop."YEAR" BETWEEN 2014 AND 2020
      AND geo."ZCTA5" IS NOT NULL
),

-- Carry previous year's population for each ZCTA
pop_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        "zip_code",
        "YEAR",
        "population",
        LAG("population") OVER (PARTITION BY "zip_code" ORDER BY "YEAR") AS "prev_population"
    FROM pop_per_zip
),

-- Compute annual growth rate and filter valid years and minimum population
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        "zip_code",
        "YEAR",
        "population",
        "prev_population",
        ("population" - "prev_population") / NULLIF("prev_population", 0) * 100.0 AS "growth_rate_pct"
    FROM pop_with_lag
    WHERE "YEAR" BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020
      AND "population" >= 25000
      AND "prev_population" IS NOT NULL
),

-- Rank within each year by growth rate descending
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        "zip_code",
        "YEAR",
        "growth_rate_pct",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "YEAR" ORDER BY "growth_rate_pct" DESC) AS "rnk"
    FROM growth_rates
)

-- Final output: second highest per year, attach state abbreviation
SELECT 
    r."zip_code",
    s."STATE_ABBREVIATION" AS "state_abbreviation",
    r."YEAR",
    ROUND(r."growth_rate_pct", 4) AS "growth_rate_pct"
FROM ranked r
INNER JOIN "US_CENSUS_GEOGRAPHY_INDEX" geo
    ON r."zip_code" = geo."ZCTA5"
INNER JOIN "US_STATE_INDEX" s
    ON geo."STATE_FIPS" = s."STATE_FIPS"
WHERE r."rnk" = 2
ORDER BY r."YEAR";
```
</details>

<details>

```sql
WITH 
    -- Get all Home Depot locations with their coordinates
    home_depot AS (
        SELECT 
            p."POI_ID",
            p."POI_NAME",
            a."LONGITUDE",
            a."LATITUDE"
        FROM 
            US_REAL_ESTATE.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTEREST_INDEX p
            JOIN US_REAL_ESTATE.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTEREST_ADDRESSES_RELATIONSHIPS pr
                ON p."POI_ID" = pr."POI_ID"
            JOIN US_REAL_ESTATE.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES a
                ON pr."ADDRESS_ID" = a."ADDRESS_ID"
        WHERE 
            LOWER(p."POI_NAME") LIKE '%the home depot%'
    ),
    -- Get all Lowe's locations with their coordinates
    lowes AS (
        SELECT 
            p."POI_ID",
            p."POI_NAME",
            a."LONGITUDE",
            a."LATITUDE"
        FROM 
            US_REAL_ESTATE.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTEREST_INDEX p
            JOIN US_REAL_ESTATE.CYBERSYN.POINT_OF_INTEREST_ADDRESSES_RELATIONSHIPS pr
                ON p."POI_ID" = pr."POI_ID"
            JOIN US_REAL_ESTATE.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES a
                ON pr."ADDRESS_ID" = a."ADDRESS_ID"
        WHERE 
            LOWER(p."POI_NAME") LIKE '%lowe''s%home improvement%'
    ),
    -- Cross join to compute all distances
    distances AS (
        SELECT 
            h."POI_ID" AS "home_depot_poi_id",
            h."POI_NAME" AS "home_depot_name",
            l."POI_ID" AS "lowes_poi_id",
            l."POI_NAME" AS "lowes_name",
            ST_DISTANCE(
                ST_MAKEPOINT(h."LONGITUDE", h."LATITUDE"),
                ST_MAKEPOINT(l."LONGITUDE", l."LATITUDE")
            ) / 1609 AS "distance_miles"
        FROM 
            home_depot h
            CROSS JOIN lowes l
    )
-- Select the nearest Lowe's for each Home Depot
SELECT 
    "home_depot_poi_id",
    "home_depot_name",
    "lowes_poi_id",
    "lowes_name",
    ROUND("distance_miles", 4) AS "distance_miles"
FROM 
    distances
QUALIFY 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "home_depot_poi_id" ORDER BY "distance_miles" ASC) = 1
ORDER BY 
    "home_depot_name";
```
</details>

```sql
    SELECT

        u."LONGITUDE",
        ST_MAKEPOINT(u."LONGITUDE", u."LATITUDE") AS "geo_point"
    FROM "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."POINT_OF_INTEREST_INDEX" p
    INNER JOIN "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."POINT_OF_INTEREST_ADDRESSES_RELATIONSHIPS" a
        ON p."POI_ID" = a."POI_ID"
    INNER JOIN "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES" u
        ON a."ADDRESS_ID" = u."ADDRESS_ID"

),

lowe AS (
    -- Get all 'Lowe's Home Improvement' locations with their addresses and coordinates
    SELECT 
        p."POI_ID",
        p."POI_NAME",
        a."ADDRESS_ID",
        u."LATITUDE",
        u."LONGITUDE",
        ST_MAKEPOINT(u."LONGITUDE", u."LATITUDE") AS "geo_point"
    FROM "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."POINT_OF_INTEREST_INDEX" p
    INNER JOIN "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."POINT_OF_INTEREST_ADDRESSES_RELATIONSHIPS" a
        ON p."POI_ID" = a."POI_ID"
    INNER JOIN "US_REAL_ESTATE"."CYBERSYN"."US_ADDRESSES" u
        ON a."ADDRESS_ID" = u."ADDRESS_ID"
    WHERE LOWER(p."POI_NAME") LIKE '%lowe''s%home%improvement%'
),

distances AS (
    -- Calculate distance from each Home Depot to every Lowe's
    SELECT 
        h."POI_ID" AS "poi_id_home_depot",
        h."POI_NAME" AS "home_depot_name",
        l."POI_ID" AS "lowe_poi_id",
        l."POI_NAME" AS "lowe_name",
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT 2010 AS loss_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT loss_year + 1
    FROM years
    WHERE loss_year < 2019
),
claim_agg AS (
    SELECT
        YEAR("DATE_OF_LOSS") AS loss_year,
        COALESCE(SUM("BUILDING_DAMAGE_AMOUNT"), 0) AS total_building_damage,
        COALESCE(SUM("CONTENTS_DAMAGE_AMOUNT"), 0) AS total_contents_damage
    FROM "WEATHER__ENVIRONMENT"."CYBERSYN"."FEMA_NATIONAL_FLOOD_INSURANCE_PROGRAM_CLAIM_INDEX"
    WHERE
        "NFIP_COMMUNITY_NAME" = 'City Of New York'
        AND YEAR("DATE_OF_LOSS") BETWEEN 2010 AND 2019
    GROUP BY YEAR("DATE_OF_LOSS")
)
SELECT
    y.loss_year,
    COALESCE(ca.total_building_damage, 0) AS total_building_damage,
    COALESCE(ca.total_contents_damage, 0) AS total_contents_damage
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN claim_agg ca ON y.loss_year = ca.loss_year
ORDER BY y.loss_year;
```

```sql
WITH yearly_damages AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_of_loss) AS year_of_loss,
        SUM(amount_paid_on_building_claim) AS total_building_damage_amounts,
        SUM(amount_paid_on_contents_claim) AS total_contents_damage_amounts
    FROM 
        "WEATHER__ENVIRONMENT"."CYBERSYN"."FEMA_NATIONAL_FLOOD_INSURANCE_PROGRAM_CLAIM_INDEX"
    WHERE 
        LOWER(nfip_community_name) LIKE LOWER('%City Of New York%')
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_of_loss) BETWEEN 2010 AND 2019
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_of_loss)
)
SELECT 
    year_of_loss,
    ROUND(total_building_damage_amounts, 2) AS total_building_damage_amounts,
    ROUND(total_contents_damage_amounts, 2) AS total_contents_damage_amounts
FROM 
    yearly_damages
ORDER BY 
    year_of_loss ASC;
```

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Sales data filtered for Manufacturing, daily, date range
sales_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
        "ORDERED_UNITS",
        "ORDERED_REVENUE",
        "SHIPPED_UNITS",
        "SHIPPED_REVENUE"
    FROM RETAIL_ANALYTICS_SALES
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07' 
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
),

-- Traffic data filtered for Manufacturing, daily, date range
traffic_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
        "GLANCE_VIEWS"
    FROM RETAIL_ANALYTICS_TRAFFIC
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07' 
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
),

-- Inventory data filtered for Manufacturing, daily, date range
inventory_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
        "PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS",
        "SELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS",
        "SELLABLE_ON_HAND_INVENTORY",
        "NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
        "NET_RECEIVED",
        "OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY",
        "UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
        "VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
        "RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
        "SELL_THROUGH_RATE",
        "OVERALL_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS"
    FROM RETAIL_ANALYTICS_INVENTORY
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07' 
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
),

-- Net PPM data filtered for Manufacturing, daily, date range
netppm_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        "DATE",
        "ASIN",
        "PROGRAM",
        "PERIOD",
        "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
        "NET_PPM"
    FROM RETAIL_ANALYTICS_NET_PPM
    WHERE "DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = 'Manufacturing'
      AND "PERIOD" = 'DAILY'
      AND "DATE" >= '2022-01-07' 
      AND "DATE" <= '2022-02-06'
)

-- Final report: daily detailed sales per product
SELECT 
    s."DATE",
    s."ASIN",
    s."PROGRAM",
    s."PERIOD",
    s."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW",
    SUM(s."ORDERED_UNITS") AS "TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS",
    SUM(s."ORDERED_REVENUE") AS "TOTAL_ORDERED_REVENUE",
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(s."ORDERED_UNITS") > 0 
            THEN SUM(s."ORDERED_REVENUE") / SUM(s."ORDERED_UNITS") 
            ELSE 0 
        END, 
        4
    ) AS "AVERAGE_SELLING_PRICE",
    SUM(t."GLANCE_VIEWS") AS "GLANCE_VIEWS",
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(t."GLANCE_VIEWS") > 0 
            THEN SUM(s."ORDERED_UNITS") / SUM(t."GLANCE_VIEWS") 
            ELSE 0 
        END, 
        4
    ) AS "CONVERSION_RATE",
    SUM(s."SHIPPED_UNITS") AS "SHIPPED_UNITS",
    SUM(s."SHIPPED_REVENUE") AS "SHIPPED_REVENUE",
    ROUND(AVG(n."NET_PPM"), 4) AS "AVERAGE_NET_PPM",
    ROUND(AVG(i."PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS"), 4) AS "AVERAGE_PROCURABLE_PRODUCT_OOS",
    SUM(i."SELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS") AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_UNITS",
    SUM(i."SELLABLE_ON_HAND_INVENTORY") AS "TOTAL_ON_HAND_VALUE",
    SUM(i."NET_RECEIVED_UNITS") AS "NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
    SUM(i."NET_RECEIVED") AS "NET_RECEIVED_VALUE",
    SUM(i."OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY") AS "OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY",
    SUM(i."UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS") AS "UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
    ROUND(AVG(i."VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE"), 4) AS "AVERAGE_VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
    ROUND(AVG(i."RECEIVE_FILL_RATE"), 4) AS "AVERAGE_RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
    ROUND(AVG(i."SELL_THROUGH_RATE"), 4) AS "AVERAGE_SELL_THROUGH_RATE",
    ROUND(AVG(i."OVERALL_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME_DAYS"), 4) AS "AVERAGE_VENDOR_LEAD_TIME"
FROM sales_cte s
LEFT JOIN traffic_cte t 
    ON s."DATE" = t."DATE" 
    AND s."ASIN" = t."ASIN" 
    AND s."PROGRAM" = t."PROGRAM" 
    AND s."PERIOD" = t."PERIOD" 
    AND s."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = t."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW"
LEFT JOIN inventory_cte i 
    ON s."DATE" = i."DATE" 
    AND s."ASIN" = i."ASIN" 
    AND s."PROGRAM" = i."PROGRAM" 
    AND s."PERIOD" = i."PERIOD" 
    AND s."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = i."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW"
LEFT JOIN netppm_cte n 
    ON s."DATE" = n."DATE" 
    AND s."ASIN" = n."ASIN" 
    AND s."PROGRAM" = n."PROGRAM" 
    AND s."PERIOD" = n."PERIOD" 
    AND s."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW" = n."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW"
GROUP BY 
    s."DATE",
    s."ASIN",
    s."PROGRAM",
    s."PERIOD",
    s."DISTRIBUTOR_VIEW"
ORDER BY 
    s."DATE",
    s."ASIN";
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH
    -- CTE to get sales data for each product
    sales_data AS (
        SELECT
            s."DATE",
            s."ASIN",
            s."PROGRAM",
            s."PERIOD",
            SUM(s."ORDERED_UNITS") AS "ordered_units",
            SUM(s."ORDERED_REVENUE") AS "ordered_revenue",
            SUM(s."SHIPPED_UNITS") AS "shipped_units",
            SUM(s."SHIPPED_REVENUE") AS "shipped_revenue"
        FROM
            "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_SALES" s
        WHERE
            s."DATE" >= '2022-01-07' AND s."DATE" < '2022-02-07'
        GROUP BY
            s."DATE",
            s."ASIN",
            s."PROGRAM",
            s."PERIOD"
    ),

    -- CTE to get traffic data
    traffic_data AS (
        SELECT
            t."DATE",
            t."ASIN",
            t."PROGRAM",
            t."PERIOD",
            SUM(t."GLANCE_VIEWS") AS "glance_views"
        FROM
            "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_TRAFFIC" t
        WHERE
            t."DATE" >= '2022-01-07' AND t."DATE" < '2022-02-07'
        GROUP BY
            t."DATE",
            t."ASIN",
            t."PROGRAM",
            t."PERIOD"
    ),

    -- CTE to get inventory data
    inventory_data AS (
        SELECT
            i."DATE",
            i."ASIN",
            i."PROGRAM",
            i."PERIOD",
            i."UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS",
            i."OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY",
            i."NET_RECEIVED_UNITS",
            i."NET_RECEIVED",
            i."VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE",
            i."RECEIVE_FILL_RATE",
            i."SELL_THROUGH_RATE",
            (i."SELLABLE_ON_HAND_INVENTORY" + i."UNSELLABLE_ON_HAND_INVENTORY") AS "total_on_hand_value",
            (i."SELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS" + i."UNSELLABLE_ON_HAND_UNITS") AS "total_on_hand_units",
            i."NET_RECEIVED" AS "net_received_value",
            0 AS "vendor_lead_time",
            0 AS "avg_procurable_product_oos"
        FROM
            "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_INVENTORY" i
        WHERE
            i."DATE" >= '2022-01-07' AND i."DATE" < '2022-02-07'
    ),

    -- CTE to get net PPM data
    net_ppm_data AS (
        SELECT
            np."DATE",
            np."ASIN",
            np."PROGRAM",
            np."PERIOD",
            AVG(np."NET_PPM") AS "avg_net_ppm"
        FROM
            "AMAZON_VENDOR_ANALYTICS__SAMPLE_DATASET"."PUBLIC"."RETAIL_ANALYTICS_NET_PPM" np
        WHERE
            np."DATE" >= '2022-01-07' AND np."DATE" < '2022-02-07'
        GROUP BY
            np."DATE",
            np."ASIN",
            np."PROGRAM",
            np."PERIOD"
    )

-- Main query joining all CTEs
SELECT
    s."DATE",
    s."ASIN",
    s."ordered_units",
    s."ordered_revenue",
    CASE WHEN s."ordered_units" > 0 THEN ROUND(s."ordered_revenue" / s."ordered_units", 4) ELSE 0 END AS "average_selling_price",
    COALESCE(t."glance_views", 0) AS "glance_views",
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(t."glance_views", 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(s."ordered_units" / t."glance_views", 4) ELSE 0 END AS "conversion_rate",
    s."shipped_units",
    s."shipped_revenue",
    COALESCE(np."avg_net_ppm", 0) AS "avg_net_ppm",
    COALESCE(i."avg_procurable_product_oos", 0) AS "avg_procurable_product_oos",
    COALESCE(i."total_on_hand_units", 0) AS "total_on_hand_units",
    COALESCE(i."total_on_hand_value", 0) AS "total_on_hand_value",
    COALESCE(i."NET_RECEIVED_UNITS", 0) AS "net_received_units",
    COALESCE(i."net_received_value", 0) AS "net_received_value",
    COALESCE(i."OPEN_PURCHASE_ORDER_QUANTITY", 0) AS "open_purchase_order_quantity",
    COALESCE(i."UNFILLED_CUSTOMER_ORDERED_UNITS", 0) AS "unfilled_customer_ordered_units",
    COALESCE(i."VENDOR_CONFIRMATION_RATE", 0) AS "average_vendor_confirmation_rate",
    COALESCE(i."RECEIVE_FILL_RATE", 0) AS "receive_fill_rate",
    COALESCE(i."SELL_THROUGH_RATE", 0) AS "sell_through_rate",
    COALESCE(i."vendor_lead_time", 0) AS "average_vendor_lead_time"
FROM
    sales_data s
LEFT JOIN
    traffic_data t
    ON s."DATE" = t."DATE" AND s."ASIN" = t."ASIN" AND s."PROGRAM" = t."PROGRAM" AND s."PERIOD" = t."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN
    inventory_data i
    ON s."DATE" = i."DATE" AND s."ASIN" = i."ASIN" AND s."PROGRAM" = i."PROGRAM" AND s."PERIOD" = i."PERIOD"
LEFT JOIN
    net_ppm_data np
    ON s."DATE" = np."DATE" AND s."ASIN" = np."ASIN" AND s."PROGRAM" = np."PROGRAM" AND s."PERIOD" = np."PERIOD"
ORDER BY
    s."DATE",
    s."ASIN"
```
</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
-- Step 1: Identify distinct zip codes in Florida
WITH florida_zips AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "ZIP", "ID_ZIP"
    FROM US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES
    WHERE "STATE" = 'FL'
),
-- Step 2: Link zip codes to geography index
zip_geos AS (
    SELECT fz."ZIP", gi."GEO_ID"
    FROM florida_zips fz
    JOIN US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_INDEX gi
        ON gi."GEO_ID" = fz."ID_ZIP"
),
-- Step 3: Compute area for each zip code using WKT polygon
zip_areas AS (
    SELECT zg."ZIP",
           ST_AREA(TO_GEOGRAPHY(gc."VALUE")) AS "AREA"
    FROM zip_geos zg
    JOIN US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.GEOGRAPHY_CHARACTERISTICS gc
        ON gc."GEO_ID" = zg."GEO_ID"
    WHERE gc."RELATIONSHIP_TYPE" = 'coordinates_wkt'
),
-- Step 4: Select the zip code with the largest area
largest_zip AS (
    SELECT "ZIP"
    FROM zip_areas
    ORDER BY "AREA" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
-- Step 5: Retrieve top 10 northernmost addresses in that zip code
SELECT "NUMBER" AS "address_number",
       "STREET" AS "street_name",
       "STREET_TYPE" AS "street_type"
FROM US_ADDRESSES__POI.CYBERSYN.US_ADDRESSES
WHERE "STATE" = 'FL'
  AND "ZIP" = (SELECT "ZIP" FROM largest_zip)
ORDER BY "LATITUDE" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
WITH
-- Step 1: Get the GEO_ID for Florida (state)
florida_geo AS (
    SELECT "GEO_ID"
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_INDEX"
    WHERE "GEO_NAME" = 'Florida'
      AND "GEO_TYPE" = 'State'
),

-- Step 2: Find all ZIP code GEO_IDs that are children of Florida
zip_geos AS (
    SELECT g."GEO_ID", g."GEOGRAPHY"
    FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_INDEX" g
    INNER JOIN "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."CYBERSYN"."GEOGRAPHY_RELATIONSHIPS" r
        ON g."GEO_ID" = r."GEO_ID"
    WHERE r."PARENT_GEO_ID" = (SELECT "GEO_ID" FROM florida_geo)
      AND g."GEO_TYPE" = 'ZIP'
),

-- Step 3: Select the ZIP code with the largest area
largest_zip AS (
    SELECT "GEO_ID", "GEOGRAPHY"
    FROM zip_geos
    ORDER BY ST_AREA("GEOGRAPHY") DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

-- Step 4: Get the 10 northernmost addresses within that ZIP code area
SELECT
    a."ADDRESS_NUMBER",
    a."STREET_NAME",
    a."STREET_TYPE"
FROM "US_ADDRESSES__POI"."PUBLIC"."ADDRESSES" a
JOIN largest_zip lz
    ON ST_WITHIN(
        ST_GEOMPOINT(a."LONGITUDE", a."LATITUDE"),
        lz."GEOGRAPHY"
    )
ORDER BY a."LATITUDE" DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Step 1: Get administrative boundaries for Amsterdam and Rotterdam
city_boundaries AS (
    SELECT 
        NAMES:"local"::VARCHAR AS city_name,
        GEO_CORDINATES AS boundary
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ADMINISTRATIVE
    WHERE ADMIN_LEVEL = '8'
      AND LOWER(NAMES:"local"::VARCHAR) IN ('amsterdam', 'rotterdam')
),

-- Step 2: Filter roads by the specified QUADKEY segments
filtered_roads AS (
    SELECT 
        CLASS,
        SUBCLASS,
        TRY_CAST(LENGTH_M AS FLOAT) AS road_length,
        GEO_CORDINATES
    FROM NETHERLANDS_OPEN_MAP_DATA.NETHERLANDS.V_ROAD
    WHERE QUADKEY LIKE '12020210%' 
       OR QUADKEY LIKE '12020211%'
),

-- Step 3: Spatially join roads to city boundaries
road_city_assignment AS (
    SELECT 
        r.CLASS,
        r.SUBCLASS,
        r.road_length,
        cb.city_name
    FROM filtered_roads r
    INNER JOIN city_boundaries cb
        ON ST_INTERSECTS(r.GEO_CORDINATES, cb.boundary)
)

-- Step 4: Aggregate total road lengths by class, subclass, and city
SELECT 
    CLASS,
    SUBCLASS,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN city_name = 'Amsterdam' THEN road_length ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Amsterdam_road_length_m",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN city_name = 'Rotterdam' THEN road_length ELSE 0 END), 4) AS "Rotterdam_road_length_m"
FROM road_city_assignment
GROUP BY CLASS, SUBCLASS
ORDER BY CLASS, SUBCLASS;
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH filtered_roads AS (
    SELECT
        "class",
        "subclass",
        "city",
        "length_meters"
    FROM "PUBLIC"."road_segments"
    WHERE "quadkey" IN ('12020210', '12020211')
      AND "city" IN ('Amsterdam', 'Rotterdam')
)
SELECT
    "class",
    "subclass",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "city" = 'Amsterdam' THEN "length_meters" ELSE 0 END) AS "amsterdam_length",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "city" = 'Rotterdam' THEN "length_meters" ELSE 0 END) AS "rotterdam_length"
FROM filtered_roads
GROUP BY "class", "subclass"
ORDER BY "class", "subclass";
```
</details>

#### 📜 Generated SQL Queries

<details>
<summary><b>View Baseline SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH top_ny_zip AS (
    SELECT 
        f."ZipCode",
        f."CensusValueByZip" AS "total_commuters_over_one_hour"
    FROM "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_CensusValues_ACS2021_ByZip" f
    INNER JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."LU_GeographyExpanded" g
        ON f."ZipCode" = g."ZipCode"
    WHERE g."PreferredStateAbbrev" = 'NY'
      AND f."MetricID" = 'B08303_013E'
    ORDER BY f."CensusValueByZip" DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    t."ZipCode",
    t."total_commuters_over_one_hour",
    b."StateBenchmarkValue" AS "state_benchmark_commuters_over_one_hour",
    b."TotalStatePopulation" AS "state_population"
FROM top_ny_zip t
CROSS JOIN "CENSUS_GALAXY__AIML_MODEL_DATA_ENRICHMENT_SAMPLE"."PUBLIC"."Fact_StateBenchmark_ACS2021" b
WHERE b."StateAbbrev" = 'NY'
  AND b."MetricID" = 'B08303_013E';
```
</details>

<details>
<summary><b>View SlayQL SQL (❌)</b></summary>

```sql
WITH 
-- Get all ZIP codes in New York State with their commuter travel time data
ny_zip_commuters AS (
    SELECT 
        "GEO_ID" AS "zip_code",
        -- Estimate total workers who travel > 1 hour (aggregate of those with travel time 60+ minutes)
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(CAST("B08303_013E" AS FLOAT), 0) + 
            COALESCE(CAST("B08303_014E" AS FLOAT), 0), 
            0
        ) AS "total_commuters_over_one_hour"
    FROM "ACS"."ACS5_2021_B08303"
    WHERE 
        "STATE" = '36'  -- New York FIPS code
        AND LENGTH("GEO_ID") = 11  -- ZIP code level (5-digit ZIP)
        AND "GEO_ID" LIKE '36%'  -- Ensure New York geography
),

-- Get NY State benchmark (percentage of workers with travel time > 1 hour at state level)
ny_state_benchmark AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(
            (COALESCE(CAST("B08303_013E" AS FLOAT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST("B08303_014E" AS FLOAT), 0)) /
            NULLIF(CAST("B08303_001E" AS FLOAT), 0) * 100, 
            4
        ) AS "state_benchmark_percentage"
    FROM "ACS"."ACS5_2021_B08303"
    WHERE 
        "GEO_ID" = '0400000US36'  -- New York State summary level
),

-- Get New York State total population from 2021 ACS
ny_state_population AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST("B01001_001E" AS FLOAT) AS "state_population"
    FROM "ACS"."ACS5_2021_B01001"
    WHERE 
        "GEO_ID" = '0400000US36'  -- New York State
),

-- Rank ZIP codes by total commuters over one hour, descending
ranked_zips AS (
    SELECT 
        "zip_code",
        "total_commuters_over_one_hour",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "total_commuters_over_one_hour" DESC) AS "rank"
    FROM "ny_zip_commuters"
    WHERE "total_commuters_over_one_hour" > 0
)

-- Final result: top ZIP code with state benchmark and population
SELECT 
    rz."zip_code",
    rz."total_commuters_over_one_hour",
    nsb."state_benchmark_percentage" AS "state_benchmark",
    nsp."state_population"
FROM "ranked_zips" rz
CROSS JOIN "ny_state_benchmark" nsb
CROSS JOIN "ny_state_population" nsp
WHERE rz."rank" = 1;
```
</details>
